Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting certain family day care providers who have been operating for at least five years from any requirement to have a high school diploma or equivalent education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to education requirements for family day careproviders; and adding a new section to chapter 43.215 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.215 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A family day care provider who as of the effective date of thissection has been licensed in operation for five years or longer andagainst whom there has not been a complaint that resulted in anenforcement action is exempt from any requirement to have a high schooldiploma or equivalent education.
